verdict.rationale: Paxos is an API platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only llms.txt and llms-full.txt AI context files and an AI assistant built into the docs. These are adjacent AI-readiness features, not an MCP server an agent can connect to, and the pack never mentions MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
